appleWalletTemplateBody.description: Design and content of an Apple Wallet (iOS) pass — a card with a front and a back whose fields map to fixed regions on the card. Field semantics follow Apple Wallet Passes (https://developer.apple.com/documentation/WalletPasses). Many text fields accept Liquid personalization tags that are replaced per recipient.

app_id.description: Optional iOS App Store identifier (for example `id123456` or `123456`). When set, the pass links to the associated app and surfaces an open-app affordance.

barcode.description: The scannable code shown on the pass.

description.description: Human-readable text shown alongside the barcode.

type.description: Barcode format — one of `PKBarcodeFormatQR`, `PKBarcodeFormatPDF417`, `PKBarcodeFormatAztec`, or `PKBarcodeFormatCode128` (Apple's format identifiers).

colors.description: Pass colors as hex values, for example `#ff0000`. All three are required.

fields.description: The pass's text content, grouped into Apple Wallet's five fixed regions. Each region holds an array of label/value entries.

auxiliary.description: A further, smallest row beneath the secondary fields — extra details such as member level or location.

back.description: The reverse side, reached by tapping the info button on the pass — long-form content such as terms, contact info, and fine print.

header.description: Top edge of the pass, beside the logo. Stays visible when the pass is stacked/collapsed in Wallet — best for the one value seen at a glance (balance, gate, points).

primary.description: The largest, most prominent text on the front, over the strip image — the headline value (the offer, the seat, the reward).

secondary.description: A smaller row beneath the primary fields — supporting details such as expiration or cardholder name.

images.description: Images shown on the pass, keyed by role. Each role occupies a fixed slot on the card. `logo` and `icon` are required; the others are optional.

background_image.description: Full-card background image. Event ticket passes only.

url.description: Public URL of the background image.

icon.description: Small icon used on the lock screen and in notifications. Required.

url.description: Public URL of the icon image.

logo.description: Brand logo, shown at the top-left of the pass. Required.

url.description: Public URL of the logo image.

preview_strip.description: Strip image shown in the "Add to Wallet" preview before the pass is installed.

url.description: Public URL of the preview strip image.

strip.description: Wide banner image shown behind the primary fields.

url.description: Public URL of the strip image.

thumbnail.description: Small square image shown to the right of the primary fields. Event ticket passes only.

url.description: Public URL of the thumbnail image.

logo_text.description: Text rendered beside the logo at the top of the pass.

nfc_message.description: Payload delivered when the pass is tapped on an NFC terminal (tap-to-interact).

organization_name.description: Organization name shown next to the lock-screen notification. Falls back to the signing certificate's value if not set.

pass_description.description: Short accessibility (VoiceOver) description of the pass. Required by Apple Wallet; defaults to the card type if left blank.

personalization_options.description: Configures the Apple Wallet sign-up form a user fills in when adding the pass, to enrol them in a rewards program. Applies to loyalty (store-card) passes only. Returned only when configured; the `api` username and password are masked in responses.

api.description: Loyalty backend the enrollment form is submitted to.

base_url.description: Base URL of the loyalty backend.

password.description: Password for the loyalty backend (HTTP Basic). Masked in responses.

username.description: Username for the loyalty backend (HTTP Basic). Masked in responses.

description.description: Text shown on the enrollment screen.

required_personalization_fields.description: Personal details collected during enrollment, for example `given_name`, `family_name`, `full_name`, `email_address`, `phone_number`, `postal_code`.

terms_and_conditions.description: Terms the user must accept to enroll.

sharing_prohibited.description: When `true`, hides the pass's share button.

strip_images.description: Per-recipient alternates of the strip banner. They share the single strip slot — only one is shown per pass, chosen at issue time by matching the recipient's `IMAGE_CODE` personalization token against `image_code`. If none matches, the default `strip` image is shown. Each `image_code` must be unique within the array.

image_code.description: Unique code used to select this image for a recipient.

url.description: Public URL of the strip image.

thank_you_message.description: Optional message shown after the pass is installed. Ignored when `thank_you_url` is set.

thank_you_url.description: Optional URL opened after the pass is installed.

trackers.description: Tracking-pixel definitions. Each renders a 1x1 image beacon that fires on a pass lifecycle event for analytics.

action.description: Lifecycle event that fires the tracker. One of `view`, `add`, or `remove`.

tag.description: Beacon URL requested when the action occurs.

external_person_id.description: A unique person identifier assigned by the brand, which can be used to link non-Vibes-assigned identifiers to Vibes person records.

person_key.description: A unique Vibes-asigned alphanumeric identifier for each person record.

name.description: The name of the campaign.
